mapper.sql: create_time , update_time, bool_delete_enum, version, id, assemble_id, artifact_id, quantity
mapper.select:
select tsa.id As assembleDetailId, tsa.quantity * artifact.quantity AS assembleQuantity, assemble.id, assemble.project_id, assemble.monomer_id, assemble.area_id, assemble.serial_number, assemble.specification, assemble.length, assemble.material, assemble.net_weight, assemble.spec_prefix, assemble.assemble_config_id, assemble.production_line_type_enum, assemble.bool_process, assemble.bool_main_assemble, assemble.bool_have_nc1 AS boolHaveNC1, artifact.structure_class_id, artifact.serial_number As artifactSerialNumber, artifact.id AS artifactId, ssc.classification_name from tech_assemble_detail tsa Left Join tech_assemble assemble on assemble.id = tsa.assemble_id and assemble.bool_delete_enum = 0 and assemble.production_line_type_enum = #{productionLineTypeEnum} Left Join tech_artifact artifact on artifact.id = tsa.artifact_id and artifact.bool_delete_enum = 0 and artifact.production_line_type_enum = #{productionLineTypeEnum} LEFT JOIN sys_structure_classification ssc on ssc.id = artifact.structure_class_id where tsa.bool_delete_enum = 0 and tsa.id in
#{item}

SELECT td.artifact_id, td.assemble_id asseOrPartId, td.quantity, ta.produced_quantity - ta.used_quantity unusedQuantity FROM tech_assemble_detail td LEFT JOIN tech_assemble ta ON td.assemble_id = ta.id WHERE td.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND ta.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND ta.bool_process = 1 AND td.artifact_id IN
#{id}
